body.statement: If \(H=\{s_{\emptyset}\}\), every selector gate is laid back on \(E_H\), and \(S\) has no latent root shared with \(V\), then \(G_H^N\) is the ordinary semi-Markovian expansion on \(V\), \(\Phi_H\) equals its ordinary observational-target relation, and \(\operatorname{SA\mbox{-}CS\mbox{-}ID}\) reduces to the ID formula-or-hedge classification of Shpitser and Pearl.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check that the new calculus agrees with classical completeness when systematic selection disappears.
body.gap: Classical ID supplies the known endpoint, while the new work must show that the support-aware state and certificate semantics collapse to it exactly.
body.consumer: Implementers can regression-test the new backend against established ID outputs on ordinary hidden-variable DAGs.
